mapper.select: SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, CASE pp.CONFIRM_STATUS WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN'PASS' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 'REJECT' WHEN 'APPROVED_RETURN' THEN 'REVIEW' END AS status, (SELECT ahc.MESSAGE_ FROM ACT_HI_COMMENT ahc WHERE pp.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID=ahc.PROC_INST_ID_ AND ahc.type_ = 'comment' ORDER BY ahc.TIME_ DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS opinion FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp WHERE pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, CASE pp.investment_status WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN'PASS' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 'REVIEW' END AS status, (SELECT ahc.MESSAGE_ FROM ACT_HI_COMMENT ahc WHERE pp.INVESTMENT_INSTANCE_ID=ahc.PROC_INST_ID_ AND ahc.type_ = 'comment' ORDER BY ahc.TIME_ DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS opinion FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp WHERE pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, CASE cc.mortgage_status WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'REVIEW' END AS status, (SELECT ahc.MESSAGE_ FROM ACT_HI_COMMENT ahc WHERE cc.MORTGAGE_INSTANCE_ID=ahc.PROC_INST_ID_ AND ahc.type_ = 'comment' ORDER BY ahc.TIME_ DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS opinion FROM CON_CONTRACT cc INNER JOIN PRJ_PROJECT pp ON cc.PROJECT_ID = pp.PROJECT_ID WHERE cc.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT pp.project_number as orderNo, to_char(reqhd.actual_pay_date,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as loanTime, to_char(reqhd.actual_hd_pay_amount*100) as loanAmount, CASE reqhd.payment_approved_status WHEN 'PAID' THEN 'SUCCESS' ELSE 'FAIL'END as status, reqhd.payment_type as type FROM prj_project pp LEFT JOIN CON_CONTRACT cc ON pp.PROJECT_ID = cc.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN csh_payment_req_hd reqhd ON reqhd.source_contract_id=cc.contract_id where pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT t.PROJECT_NUMBER FROM ( SELECT pp.PROJECT_ID, pp.PROJECT_NAME, pp.PROJECT_NUMBER, pp.PROJECT_STATUS, pp.CREATION_DATE, pp.INVESTMENT_STATUS, (SELECT max( END_TIME_ ) FROM ACT_HI_PROCINST ahp WHERE ahp.BUSINESS_KEY_ = pp.PROJECT_ID and pp.project_status='APPROVED' AND INSTR( ahp.PROC_DEF_ID_, 'FORMAL_APPROVAL_WORK_FLOW' ) > 0 ) approved_time FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp left join hls_bp_master hbm on pp.MANUFACTURER_ID = hbm.bp_id where hbm.bp_code in ('BP202408090380','BP202407230057') ) t WHERE (NVL(t.PROJECT_STATUS, 'NEW') NOT IN ('APPROVED','APPROVING') AND trunc( SYSDATE ) - 30 > trunc(t.CREATION_DATE)) OR (t.PROJECT_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND NVL(t.INVESTMENT_STATUS, 'NEW') NOT IN ('APPROVED','APPROVING') AND trunc( SYSDATE ) - 50 > trunc(t.approved_time))

SELECT ccc.CASHFLOW_ID AS cashflowId, pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, ccc.TIMES AS termNo, TO_CHAR(ccc.FIN_INCOME_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') AS trialTime, NVL(ccc.PRINCIPAL, 0)*100 AS principal, NVL(ccc.INTEREST, 0)*100 AS interest, 0 AS penalty, NVL(ccc.DUE_AMOUNT, 0)*100 AS payableAmount FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW ccc INNER JOIN CON_CONTRACT cc ON ccc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID INNER JOIN PRJ_PROJECT pp ON cc.project_id = pp.project_id INNER JOIN hls_bp_master hbm on pp.MANUFACTURER_ID = hbm.bp_id WHERE cc.contract_status = 'INCEPT' AND ccc.write_off_flag not in ('FULL') AND ccc.cf_direction='INFLOW' AND ccc.times not in (0) and nvl(ccc.plan_type,'NO') not in ('COMP','REPO') AND ccc.cf_item not in (9) AND ccc.due_amount-nvl(ccc.RECEIVED_AMOUNT,0)>0 AND trunc(sysdate) - nvl(pp.compen_day,30) > trunc(ccc.DUE_DATE) AND trunc(sysdate) - nvl(pp.buy_back_day,85) < trunc(ccc.DUE_DATE) AND hbm.bp_code in ('BP202408090380','BP202407230057')
AND ccc.CASHFLOW_ID = #{cashflowId}
SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, DECODE(pp.ALIPAY_STATUS, 'ACTIVATED','FINISHED','CANCELED','CANCLE','') status FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp WHERE pp.PROJECT_ID = #{ projectId}
SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, 'DEDUCT' repayType FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp where pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT ccc.TIMES AS termNo, NVL(ccc.PRINCIPAL, 0)*100 AS principal, NVL(ccc.INTEREST, 0)*100 AS interest, (SELECT NVL(SUM(cf.DUE_AMOUNT), 0)*100 FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW cf WHERE cf.GENERATED_SOURCE_DOC_ID = ccc.CASHFLOW_ID AND CF_ITEM=9) AS penalty, (SELECT NVL(cf1.DUE_AMOUNT, 0)*100 FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW cf1 WHERE cf1.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID AND cf1.CF_ITEM=8) AS otherFee, ccc.DUE_AMOUNT*100 + (SELECT NVL(SUM(cf.DUE_AMOUNT), 0)*100 FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW cf WHERE cf.GENERATED_SOURCE_DOC_ID = ccc.CASHFLOW_ID AND CF_ITEM=9) + (SELECT NVL(cf1.DUE_AMOUNT, 0)*100 FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW cf1 WHERE cf1.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID AND cf1.CF_ITEM=8) AS total, ct.TRANSACTION_NO AS transactionNo, ct.EXTERNAL_DEDUCT_NO AS externalDeductNo FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CCC INNER JOIN CON_CONTRACT cc on cc.CONTRACT_ID = ccc.CONTRACT_ID INNER JOIN CSH_TRANSACTION ct on cc.CONTRACT_ID = ct.CONTRACT_ID AND ct.TERM_NO = ccc.times INNER JOIN PRJ_PROJECT pp ON pp.PROJECT_ID = cc.PROJECT_ID WHERE ct.PAYMENT_METHOD = '代偿' AND ccc.CF_ITEM=1 AND pp.PROJECT_ID=#{projectId}
